mechanism: Betamethasone may increase abacavir metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing antiretroviral efficacy, while abacavir carries inherent hypersensitivity risk that may be masked by corticosteroid immunosuppression.
action: Monitor viral load and CD4 count closely; consider alternative corticosteroid or ensure adequate abacavir dosing; counsel on hypersensitivity syndrome recognition despite steroid use.
